{{Quote|General Garza rerouted us from a two-week sightseeing op on Ryloth to assist you, Lieutenant. Looks like you've already taken care of things, though.|Lieutenant Tasser, to the Havoc Squad commander on Tatooine|<ref name="Evacuation" />}}
The '''43rd Advance Recon Squad''' was the Republic squad of which [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tasser]] was a member. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza|Garza]] rerouted the squad from an operation on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to assist [[Havoc Squad]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When they arrived, they took [[Vanto Bazren]] into Republic custody.
